 2026-10-22 02:53 
 Caleb Wilson posted 16 points, 4 rebounds, 3 steals, and 1 block but committed 9 turnovers, shot 7-of-21 from the field, and finished a record-worst -45 in plus-minus for an NBA debut.

 Caleb Wilson finds himself authoring an unwanted record in NBA history following his official debut for the Chicago Bulls on Wednesday.

 As the Bulls suffered a brutal 135-92 loss in their 2026-27 season opener in Toronto against the Raptors, the Chicago rookie recorded the worst-ever plus-minus in NBA history for his first career game.
 The reigning No. 4 pick of this year's draft tallied an awful -45, surpassing the record of Jalen Green in his 2020-21 rookie debut for the Houston Rockets.
 Caleb Wilson drops worst NBA debut game in Bulls loss vs. Raptors
 Wednesday night was particularly horrible for the Chicago Bulls as they got demolished by the Toronto Raptors led by the returning Kawhi Leonard.
 Caleb Wilson specifically tallied 16 points, four rebounds, and three steals, but he shot 7-of-21 from the field and went 1-of-8 from three-point range alongside 9 turnovers
 These disastrous numbers significantly impacted his all-time low record of -45 plus-minus in 32 minutes.
 Wilson couldn't be more determined to bounce back from his forgettable NBA debut, as he and the Bulls will face the Milwaukee Bucks next on Friday.
